Order of operations for sort:

1.  Create rank matrix A and replicate the input into matrix B
2.  Let C be the subtraction of A with the plaintext constant matrix
3.  Find the index of the C and multiply the index with B
4.  Sum the product of C and B and transpose to finish the sort
